name: pokemap-reference-builder
description: Analyze exterior references, resolve native assets, and gate editable PokeMap reconstruction against semantic and rendered fidelity.

interface.shortDescription: Rebuild exterior maps from visual references.
interface.longDescription: Builds assisted semantic blueprints from exterior reference images, resolves exact-footprint HGSS/DS assets, blocks invalid spatial compositions, and enforces an 80 percent review gate on both semantic structure and same-crop rendered fidelity before applying approved families through the canonical PokeMap MCP workflow.
defaultPrompt: Rebuild this exterior reference as an editable PokeMap map.
Decode this map image into semantic 32 px layers.
Create a correctly sized missing HGSS-style asset.
Compare this PokeMap render with its reference and block it below the quality gate.
